L2·N4902unmasked layer
Fires on sub-word/fragment tokens that complete a fixed multi-token unit — the space immediately before "100%", the second piece of a truncated proper noun ("Zeh|ut", "Z|ech."), and the middle of hyphenated/idiomatic phrases ("up|-to|-date", "well| on| our way") — i.e. a surface-form continuation detector rather than a semantic one (strongly suppressed by non-English word fragments like Dutch/German "eraan", "Dafür").
